My Guard: Jung Yong-hwa, Hong Seung-hee stumble in trifling fantasy romcom 
 A wealthy agoraphobe’s dream to star in a drama with her favourite actor leads to predictable misunderstandings and clichés
 3 -MIN READ 3 -MIN Listen Pierce Conran in Seoul Published: 9:15pm, 29 Oct 2026 Lead cast: Jung Yong-hwa, Hong Seung-hee, Lee Yi-kyung, Park Yoo-na
 Jung Yong-hwa ( Sell Your Haunted House ) and Hong Seung-hee ( To the Moon ) headline Oh! My Guard , a frothy fantasy romantic comedy set in the entertainment world. The general rule with K-drama romcoms is that opposites attract, and at first this appears to hold true for TV actor Uhm Tae-bong (Jung) and wealthy agoraphobe Oh Hae-ra (Hong).
